_note: Source of truth for audio generation. voice/sfx/music keys mirror docs/game-design.md section 8 (+ docs/game-design-v2.md: Grabble NPC, mini-games). phase: 1 narrator, 2 characters, 3 catcher sfx, 4 priority music, 5 other sfx, 6 other music. v2 adds 26 narrator lines, 5 character lines, 21 sfx. The puppy hero is named Charli in spoken text; keys keep 'pup'. v3 adds Benny (baker hero, 11 lines, voice Chris) and Miss Suds (1 reply, voice Matilda), phase 2.

voice.text: Welcome to the village! Scan the code with your phone to join the adventure.
A new friend has arrived!
Grabble has scattered the Starlight Gem into shards all over the village! Collect enough shards to make it whole again, before Grabble fills his bag. Ready... go!
Your turn! Roll the dice!
Hello? It's your turn! Give the dice a roll.
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
Five!
Six!
Ting! A starlight shard, glowing under the flowers!
Look under the flowers! A shard!
Swish! Grabble snatched a shard! Hey, that isn't yours!
Swish! Grabble's net came up empty. Nothing to snatch!
Charli wants to fetch! Pick a friend.
Woof! Charli fetched a shard from a friend!
Woof! Nobody had a shard, so Charli found one in the sky!
Teatime! Cake for everyone! Everybody gets a shard.
Flying takes practice. So does landing!
A quiet cobblestone. Nothing here but flowers.
Small kindness, brighter days.
A fairy flight! Would you like to fly across the village?
Whoosh! Up and over the rooftops!
Staying put. Maybe next time!
You landed on the bridge. Careful, the Catcher is right above you!
Time to launch the Catcher! Who will you send to the bridge?
Off to the bridge they go!
Ring the bell when the star glows brightest!
Ready... sing!
Caught in the flower basket! I'm stuck! Hand over a shard!
Everyone on the bridge is caught! A shard from each of them!
Caught! But their pockets are empty. No shards to give.
Perfect ring! The whole village heard that bell!
Hop! Missed me! The basket swung wide.
Home to the castle! Two bonus shards for making it all the way around!
Five shards! Just one more to make the Starlight Gem whole!
The Starlight Gem is whole again! A flower lock, with a musical key. We did it... together!
Teamwork... and then cake!
Welcome back!
Kind hearts, brighter tomorrows!
Dream brighter together!
Bloom!!
Flowers, catch him!
Got it!
We'll protect it. Together!
La-la-la!
Ding!
Music, lift the gem!
We did it!!
That gem will be... mine!
Especially... shiny things!
Missed me!
I'm... stuck!
Only my pride is a bit squashed.
Just one more shard to make the Starlight Gem whole!
Watch out! Grabble is sneaking around the village, snatching shards for himself. Don't let him fill his bag!
Grabble scurries ahead…
Swish! Grabble snatched a shard!
Grabble pocketed a shard. Especially shiny things!
Grabble stopped on the bridge. Quick, someone launch the Catcher!
Oh no! Grabble filled his bag and ran off with the starlight. Play again to stop him!
You caught up with Grabble! Flowers, catch him!
Got it! You took shards back from Grabble!
Got him! But his bag was empty.
Hop! Missed me! Grabble skipped away.
Grabble is on the bridge. Ring the bell!
Grabble is stuck in the basket! His shiny loot spills everywhere!
Tap to flap through the flower rings!
Tap the flower that twinkles!
Slide Charli to catch the falling shards!
Hop when Grabble's net glows!
Tap the strawberries onto the cake!
Hold to grow the vine, let go when it reaches Grabble!
Wonderful!
Nice try!
What a flight! A bonus shard!
Two shards under the flowers!
Charli took a shard back from Grabble!
You hopped away! Grabble tripped over his net!
Perfect cake! An extra slice for you!
All mine, mine, mine!
Whoa! My net!
Hop! Too slow!
Grow, little vine!
Flying takes practice!
Good morning, Miss Suds! You look as bright as a sunbeam today!
Miss Suds, your bubbles are the sparkliest in the whole village!
A fresh bun for the loveliest pet washer in town!
After you, Miss Suds! Kindness first!
Miss Suds, you make every puppy smile. And me too!
Is it warm in here, or is it just your smile, Miss Suds?
Oh! Hi, Miss Suds… I mean, um, hello!
The biggest slice of cake for Miss Suds!
Sorry, Miss Suds, nothing personal! You look lovely even in a flower basket!
That one's for you, Miss Suds!
Go, Miss Suds! You've got this!
Why, thank you, Benny!

This cue re-cuts it as raw 0-6, 4-12, 8-14, 10-12, 8-end (joins 6->4, 12->8, 14->10, 12->8, each a whole number of bars, equal-power crossfade 0.5 s), so intro + build are extended by 14 s and the original riser + hit + tail still end the cue. Built from the cached music_catcher raw: no API spend.
